item.text:
Refactored the frontend API layer so endpoint code no longer owns raw `fetch` parsing and error shaping.

- [frontend/src/http.js](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/exp-app/frontend/src/http.js#L1) adds a reusable `requestJson` helper plus an `ApiError` type that preserves status and response body.
- [frontend/src/api.js](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/exp-app/frontend/src/api.js#L1) now only defines the comments endpoint and returns `data.comments`.

Validation:
- `node --check` passed for `frontend/src/http.js`, `frontend/src/api.js`, `frontend/src/useAsyncData.js`, `frontend/src/useComments.js`, and `frontend/src/formatters.js`.
- `git diff --check` is clean.

If you want another pass, the next clean seam is either:
1. Trim the remaining backend model registry boilerplate in [backend/models/index.js](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/exp-app/backend/models/index.js#L1).
2. Generalize the new `requestJson` helper to support non-JSON responses and status-specific messages.
